q: True or false: A Level 1 hospital checklist requires a Neonatal Intensive Care Unit.
n: NICU first appears at Level 2. Remember this: Level 1 → Level 2 adds NICU, ICU and high-risk pregnancy; Level 3 adds dialysis, rehabilitation, histopathology, decontamination room and morgue autopsy. Labs climb 20 → 60 sq. m. Word root: infirmary = Latin infirmus "not strong".

q: Fill in the blank: Level 2–3 tertiary lab work area = at least ___ sq. m.
Match the facility to the special room: Ambulatory Surgical Clinic (lithotripsy) →
n: Lithotripsy uses imaging and shock waves.
